meta.source: 82 results/**/*_info.json (81 paired with their planned tour; sub_sc1_test has no plan); review2 re-runs de-duplicated per identical converted leg

definitions.ratio_raw: fuel_leg / dm_plan as recorded by convert_tour (planned mass chain)
definitions.ratio_fix: fuel_leg / dm_model(m_pre_actual, dv_est, tof): planned dm re-evaluated at the actual pre-leg mass (used for the surrogate)
definitions.u: dv_est / (a*tof) with a = Tmax/m_pre: thrust-utilisation fraction; planner feasibility is u <= 0.6
definitions.families: patient: m0 <= 1300 kg; chaser: m0 >= 1600 kg; mid: 1300-1600
definitions.categories: launch: leg 0 (excluded from ratios); ordinary: matched to plan with no dropped target immediately before it; post_drop: first flown leg after a dropped planned target (stale dm_plan); replan: legs after a beam re-plan from the actual state; censored: legs solved then dropped by expensive_drop (fuel > 80 kg and > max(3x, +60 kg) plan) - never flown

primary.name: M8_patient_LAD
primary.formula: fuel_leg_kg = (m_pre/VE) * (d0 + c1*dv) * (tof/200 d)^q ; VE = 39.2266 km/s, m_pre = actual (predicted) mass before the leg, dv = planner junction dv_est [km/s], tof = leg time of flight; launch leg (leg 0) NOT included: add launch allowance
primary.fitted_on: 593 ordinary patient legs, least-absolute log error (median-unbiased)
primary.note: per-leg median-unbiased; the heavy right tail makes sums 10% larger: expected tour propellant = 1.10 * sum f + launch; per-tour LOO scatter of sum(actual)/sum(f): median 1.03, p10 0.87, p90 1.28

launch_allowance_kg.rule: first-leg tof < 120 d: ~3 kg; 120-200 d: ~7 kg; > 200 d: median 19, mean 31 kg

M4_chaser_LAD.note: chaser legs have a 4x larger tof-proportional term; do not use the patient surrogate for 2000 kg chasers

piecewise_multiplier_patient.usage: actual ~= median * dm_plan(m_actual); for sums use mean

tour_level.notes: A = actual, P = planned (dm_plan at the conversion m0). new = current convert_tour defaults (adaptive_iter, widen_on_fail); old = fleet_b300/sub_* and extra_* (pre-review2 converter)

implied_tour_ratio.note: ratio includes: mass growth at the sized tank (~1.07-1.09), ordinary-leg surrogate x1.10 tail, mean launch leg 16.8 kg; excludes lost flybys (7% of planned targets in patient tours) and post-drop legs
